summary: Character normalization helper: selects a conversion path based on the cbMultiByte encoding mode global. When cbMultiByte <= 1 it tests flag bit 4 of a lookup-table entry indexed by the character; otherwise it delegates to CharacterEncodingConvertViaLookupTableFallback with the same bit test. If the bit test fails it returns an uppercased (mask 0xFFFFFFDF) form of the input minus 7; if the bit is set it returns the input unchanged. Called by sub_58E4D2.

operations.description: v1 = CharType: preserve the original input for the unchanged return path.
Branch on the cbMultiByte encoding-mode global: if cbMultiByte <= 1 use the direct lookup-table bit test, else call the fallback conversion routine.
v2 = off_5E69C8[0][CharType] & 4: test flag bit 4 of the per-character lookup-table entry for the encoding-conversion path.
v2 = CharacterEncodingConvertViaLookupTableFallback(CharType, 4): delegate the same bit-4 conversion test to the fallback routine when cbMultiByte > 1.
Guard on the conversion flag: if v2 is zero the lookup reported no conversion, so fall through to the transform path.
return (CharType & 0xFFFFFFDF) - 7: mask the input to its uppercase form and subtract 7, producing the converted output.
Return the converted value when the flag bit was clear, otherwise return the original input v1.
Invoked by sub_58E4D2 as part of its character-handling path.

unresolved: Meaning of flag bit 4 in the lookup-table entry and the character transform (CharType & 0xFFFFFFDF) - 7 is not established from this function alone.
Role of the cbMultiByte encoding-mode global and the distinction between the two lookup paths is not documented here.
